data.one_liner: WidgetFactory mixin to launch links in HTML widgets via url_launcher.
data.what_it_does: Provides a UrlLauncherFactory mixin that enables <a> tags rendered by flutter_widget_from_html to open URLs using the url_launcher plugin. It bridges HTML rendering with native link handling on all supported platforms.
use_when: You render HTML with flutter_widget_from_html and need clickable links.
You want cross‑platform URL launching without writing custom link handlers.
avoid_when: You need advanced url_launcher features not exposed through the mixin.
strengths: Very easy to add to an existing HtmlWidget factory.
Works out‑of‑the‑box on Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS and Linux.
weaknesses: Adds an extra dependency on url_launcher.
data.setup_notes: Add url_launcher to pubspec and follow its platform‑specific setup (e.g., Android intent filters, iOS LSApplicationQueriesSchemes). No code generation required.

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: Direct use of url_launcher gives full control without needing the HTML widget integration.
